findings.head: 6aa01995f6dcb94fd28d358badc9f8d1e0273d39
findings.repair: Typed execution receipts bind observations to command, environment, actual commit/tree, result and hashed output. Unsupported PASS and boolean exit substitutions are rejected.
findings.limit: Evidence-consistency and filesystem-safety contract only; not hostile concurrent-filesystem transactional security or external approval.
